title: Nindati-chandana / Sa virahe tava dina
edition: Sourindro Mohun Tagore, Six Principal Ragas, second edition, 1877, appendix pages vi-viii

conventionEvidence.finding: Vertical vibhajika rekha divides the tala's mancha by matras; translated as bars.
Madhyamana example labels eight matras to the bar; mapping to appendix Western quarter notes is not explained.

openingIndependentlyConfirmed.finding: Dotted eighth, two thirty-seconds and four sixteenths. Main visual reading and independent agent agree.

independentRhythmReview.restConvention: Left-facing one-hook rest is an eighth; two-hook rest is a sixteenth. Do not count staff lines as rest hooks.
independentRhythmReview.triplets: Single-beamed triplets marked 3 have one-third quarter-beat duration per note.
independentRhythmReview.dottedRest: D7 contains a dotted eighth rest, three-quarters of a quarter beat.
independentRhythmReview.repeat: PDF116 first staff double bar has dots on both sides; following rest belongs after the boundary. Final staff plain double bar has no repeat dots.
independentRhythmReview.slurs: Curves connecting different pitches are not ties.
